chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-01.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-01.body: By parts, $\int\frac{\ln x}{x^3}dx=-\frac{\ln x}{2x^2}-\frac1{4x^2}$. From $1$ to $e$: $\left(-\frac1{2e^2}-\frac1{4e^2}\right)-\left(-\frac14\right)=\frac14-\frac3{4e^2}=\frac{e^2-3}{4e^2}$.

chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-03.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-03.body: $\sin x$ is odd, so $x^2\sin x$, $x^4\sin x$, $x^8\sin x$ are odd and integrate to $0$; $x\sin x$ is even: $2\int_0^1x\sin x\,dx=2[\sin x-x\cos x]_0^1=2(\sin1-\cos1)$.

chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-06.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-06.body: Put $x=-y$: $\int_0^{\pi/2}\frac{dy}{\sqrt{1+\sin y}}$. $1+\sin y=2\sin^2\left(\frac y2+\frac\pi4\right)$, so the integrand is $\frac1{\sqrt2\sin(y/2+\pi/4)}$, with antiderivative $\sqrt2\ln\tan\left(\frac y4+\frac\pi8\right)$. From $0$ to $\frac\pi2$: $\sqrt2\big(\ln\tan\frac\pi4-\ln\tan\frac\pi8\big)=-\sqrt2\ln(\sqrt2-1)=\sqrt2\ln(\sqrt2+1)$.

chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-07.title: Solution
chmmc-cmm-2026-bee-qual-07.body: Polynomial division: $x^6-2x^5+x^4=(x^2+1)(x^4-2x^3+2x-2)+2x^2-2x+2$, and $\frac{2x^2-2x+2}{x^2+1}=2-\frac{2x}{x^2+1}$. So the integrand is $x^4-2x^3+2x-\frac{2x}{1+x^2}$ and the integral is $\frac15-\frac12+1-\ln2=\frac7{10}-\ln2$.
